svg.aria-label: AI-integrated systems: transformer forward pass architecture from question to 5 autonomous outcomes
svg.desc: Smooth, GPU-accelerated walkthrough of a transformer forward pass: character-by-character typewriter ingestion, BPE subword tokenisation, embedding lookup matrix with serial extrusions, multi-head self-attention arcs, FFN echo-stack with scanning layer sweeps, and 5 autoregressive generation loops with smooth card sliding and true sequence extension.
svg.text: athrLabs · systems that learn as you work

g.text: What can AI do for my business?
Trained on your data, shaped to your work.
